contentText: Schools were evacuated across Italy on Wednesday following a series of hoax bomb threats. Similar hoax threats were reported in schools in Britain, Scotland and Ireland. The threats come after a series of hoax bomb alerts in recent weeks including on flights across Europe and cyber attacks on supermarket refrigeration systems in several European countries, including Italy. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Jamie Smith-Maillet tells us more.
